ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'If we had the account of earlier people with us' in Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Surah As-Saff, this verse highlights the believers' longing for the complete, uncorrupted revelations of earlier prophets to strengthen their resolve, contrasting with the partial or altered texts available at the time. Shia exegesis often interprets this as a reflection on the continuity of divine guidance and the unique status of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate custodians of truth. It underscores the theme of steadfastness in faith despite the challenges of preserving and implementing divine law.
